maddeler.e:
تحتضنوا (form VIII)
# تَحْتَضِنُوا (taḥtaḍinū) /taħ.ta.dˤi.nuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَضَنَ (iḥtaḍana)
# تُحْتَضَنُوا (tuḥtaḍanū) /tuħ.ta.dˤa.nuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَضَنَ (iḥtaḍana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
